```{r module-5-conversion-models, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# Fit the six prespecified GLM/GAM conversion specifications.
# Use validation log loss for model selection and hold out test outcomes.
# Monte Carlo-safe model selection contract: M5-GLMGAM-OOT-2026-09-18-MC-SAFE

required_packages <- c( "tidyverse", "broom", "mgcv" )
missing_packages <- required_packages[ !required_packages %in% rownames( installed.packages() ) ]
if ( length( missing_packages ) > 0L
) {
  stop( paste0( "Install the following packages before running Module 5: ", paste( missing_packages,
        collapse = ", " ) ) )
}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(broom)
  library(mgcv)
})
options( dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE, scipen = 999 )
config <- list( seed = 20260817L,
  input_dir = file.path("outputs", "conversion_generation"),
  output_dir = file.path("outputs", "conversion_models"),
  modelling_file = "conversion_data.csv", upstream_validation_file = "conversion_generation_validation_checks.csv",
  upstream_vehicle_specification_audit_file = "conversion_vehicle_specification_audit.csv",
  truth_file = "conversion_truth.rds", 
  market_scenario_id = "baseline",
   demand_scenario_id = "baseline",
  expected_policy_year = 2025L, expected_profiles = 50000L, expected_conversion_train_rows = 30000L,
  expected_conversion_validation_rows = 10000L, expected_conversion_test_rows = 10000L, probability_clip = 1e-6,
  calibration_bins = 10L, minimum_training_events = 300L, minimum_validation_events = 75L,
  minimum_test_events = 75L,
  # The nonlinear GAM is selected only if its validation improvement over the
  # interpretable Market-position GLM is material and calibration is acceptable.
  minimum_relative_logloss_improvement_for_gam = 0.005, gam_calibration_slope_lower = 0.70,
  gam_calibration_slope_upper = 1.30,
  # Broad held-out validation gates.
  final_test_oe_lower = 0.75, final_test_oe_upper = 1.25, final_test_calibration_slope_lower = 0.60,
  final_test_calibration_slope_upper = 1.40,
  # Feature-engineering threshold aligned to the baseline DGP's main
  # relative-price tolerance region. It remains an observable engineered feature;
  # the fitted model does not receive the true DGP threshold parameter.
  market_gap_threshold = 0.08, write_plots = TRUE )
set.seed(
  config$seed )
dir.create(
  config$output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE )
```

```{r module-5-conversion-models, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 1. UTILITY FUNCTIONS
safe_divide <- function( numerator, denominator
) {
  result <- numerator / denominator
  invalid <- !is.finite( result )
  result[ invalid ] <- NA_real_
  result
}
clip_probability <- function( probability, epsilon = config$probability_clip
) {
  pmin( pmax( as.numeric( probability ), epsilon ), 1 - epsilon )
}
assert_columns <- function( data, required_columns, data_name
) {
  missing_columns <- setdiff( required_columns, names( data ) )
  if ( length( missing_columns ) > 0L
  ) {
    stop( paste0( data_name, " is missing required columns: ", paste( missing_columns, collapse = ", " ) ) )
  }
}
set_reference_level <- function( x, reference_level, variable_name
) {
  x_factor <- factor( as.character( x ), ordered = FALSE )
  if ( !reference_level %in% levels( x_factor )
  ) {
    stop( paste0( "Reference level '", reference_level, "' is not present for ", variable_name,
        ". Available levels: ", paste( levels( x_factor ), collapse = ", " ) ) )
  }
  stats::relevel( x_factor, ref = reference_level )
}
auc_rank <- function( outcome, probability
) {
  outcome <- as.integer( outcome )
  probability <- as.numeric( probability )
  keep <- is.finite( outcome ) & is.finite( probability )
  outcome <- outcome[ keep ]
  probability <- probability[ keep ]
  positive_count <- sum( outcome == 1L )
  negative_count <- sum( outcome == 0L )
  if ( positive_count == 0L || negative_count == 0L
  ) {
    return( NA_real_ )
  }
  probability_rank <- rank( probability, ties.method = "average" )
  positive_rank_sum <- sum( probability_rank[ outcome == 1L ] )
  ( positive_rank_sum - positive_count * ( positive_count + 1 ) / 2 ) / ( positive_count * negative_count )
}
calibration_statistics <- function( outcome, probability
) {
  probability <- clip_probability( probability )
  linear_predictor <- stats::qlogis( probability )
  intercept_fit <- tryCatch( suppressWarnings( stats::glm( outcome ~ 1, offset = linear_predictor, family =
            stats::binomial() ) ),
      error = function(e) {
        NULL
      } )
  slope_fit <- tryCatch( suppressWarnings( stats::glm( outcome ~ linear_predictor, family = stats::binomial() ) ),
      error = function(e) {
        NULL
      } )
  calibration_intercept <- if ( !is.null( intercept_fit )
    ) {
      unname( stats::coef( intercept_fit )[ 1 ] )
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
  calibration_slope <- if ( !is.null( slope_fit ) && length( stats::coef( slope_fit ) ) >= 2L
    ) {
      unname( stats::coef( slope_fit )[ 2 ] )
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
  c( calibration_intercept = calibration_intercept, calibration_slope = calibration_slope )
}
expected_calibration_error <- function( outcome, probability, bins = config$calibration_bins
) {
  calibration_data <- tibble( outcome = as.integer( outcome ), probability = clip_probability( probability ) ) %>%
    mutate( calibration_bin = ntile( probability, bins ) ) %>% group_by( calibration_bin ) %>% summarise(
      observations = n(), observed_rate = mean( outcome ), predicted_rate = mean( probability ), .groups = "drop" )
  weighted.mean( abs( calibration_data$observed_rate - calibration_data$predicted_rate ), w =
      calibration_data$observations )
}
binary_model_metrics <- function( outcome, probability
) {
  outcome <- as.integer( outcome )
  probability <- clip_probability( probability )
  if ( length( outcome ) != length( probability )
  ) {
    stop( "Outcome and prediction vectors must have equal length." )
  }
  calibration <- calibration_statistics( outcome, probability )
  observed_rate <- mean( outcome )
  predicted_rate <- mean( probability )
  top_decile_cutoff <- quantile( probability, probs = 0.90, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE )
  top_decile_event_rate <- mean( outcome[ probability >= top_decile_cutoff ] )
  tibble( observations = length( outcome ), events = sum( outcome ), observed_conversion_rate = observed_rate,
    predicted_conversion_rate = predicted_rate, observed_to_expected = safe_divide( observed_rate, predicted_rate
      ), log_loss = -mean( outcome * log( probability ) + ( 1 - outcome ) * log( 1 - probability ) ), brier_score =
      mean( ( outcome - probability )^2 ), auc = auc_rank( outcome, probability ), calibration_intercept = unname(
        calibration[ "calibration_intercept" ] ), calibration_slope = unname( calibration[ "calibration_slope" ] ),
    expected_calibration_error = expected_calibration_error( outcome, probability ), top_decile_event_rate =
      top_decile_event_rate, top_decile_lift = safe_divide( top_decile_event_rate, observed_rate ) )
}
fit_model_safely <- function( formula, data, model_type, model_name
) {
  tryCatch(
    {
      fitted_model <- if ( model_type == "glm"
        ) {
          stats::glm( formula = formula, data = data, family = stats::binomial( link = "logit" ), control =
              stats::glm.control( maxit = 100 ) )
        } else if ( model_type == "gam"
        ) {
          mgcv::gam( formula = formula, data = data, family = stats::binomial( link = "logit" ), method = "REML",
            select = TRUE )
        } else {
          stop( paste0( "Unknown model type: ", model_type ) )
        }
      if ( inherits( fitted_model, "glm" ) && !inherits( fitted_model, "gam" ) && !isTRUE( fitted_model$converged )
      ) {
        stop( paste0( model_name, " did not converge." ) )
      }
      fitted_model
    },
    error = function(e) {
      warning( paste0( model_name, " failed to fit: ", conditionMessage( e ) ) )
      NULL
    } )
}
predict_probability_safely <- function( model, new_data, model_name
) {
  if ( is.null( model )
  ) {
    return( rep( NA_real_, nrow( new_data ) ) )
  }
  predictions <- tryCatch(
      {
        stats::predict( model, newdata = new_data, type = "response" )
      },
      error = function(e) {
        stop( paste0( "Prediction failed for ", model_name, ": ", conditionMessage( e ) ) )
      } )
  if ( length( predictions ) != nrow( new_data )
  ) {
    stop( paste0( "Prediction length mismatch for ", model_name, "." ) )
  }
  if ( any( !is.finite( predictions ) )
  ) {
    stop( paste0( "Non-finite predictions generated by ", model_name, "." ) )
  }
  clip_probability( predictions )
}
make_calibration_table <- function( data, probability_column, group_column
) {
  probability_symbol <- rlang::ensym( probability_column )
  group_symbol <- rlang::ensym( group_column )
  data %>% group_by( !!group_symbol ) %>% summarise( profiles = n(), conversions = sum( focal_conversion ),
      observed_conversion_rate = mean( focal_conversion ), predicted_conversion_rate = mean( !!probability_symbol
        ), observed_to_expected = safe_divide( observed_conversion_rate, predicted_conversion_rate ), .groups =
        "drop" )
}
add_wald_intervals <- function( tidy_table
) {
  required_columns <- c( "estimate", "std.error" )
  if ( !all( required_columns %in% names( tidy_table ) )
  ) {
    stop( paste0( "Wald intervals require columns: ", paste( required_columns, collapse = ", " ) ) )
  }
  tidy_table %>% mutate( conf.low = estimate - qnorm( 0.975 ) * std.error, conf.high = estimate + qnorm( 0.975 ) *
          std.error, odds_ratio = exp( estimate ), odds_ratio_low = exp( conf.low ), odds_ratio_high = exp(
          conf.high ) )
}
```

```{r module-5-conversion-models, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 2. READ AND VALIDATE MODULE 4 INPUT
modelling_path <- file.path( config$input_dir, config$modelling_file )
upstream_validation_path <- file.path( config$input_dir, config$upstream_validation_file )
upstream_vehicle_specification_audit_path <- file.path( config$input_dir,
  config$upstream_vehicle_specification_audit_file )
truth_path <- file.path( config$input_dir, config$truth_file )
required_upstream_files <- c( modelling_path, upstream_validation_path, upstream_vehicle_specification_audit_path,
  truth_path )
missing_upstream_files <- required_upstream_files[ !file.exists( required_upstream_files ) ]
if ( length( missing_upstream_files ) > 0L
) {
  stop( paste0( "Required revised Module 4 input(s) not found: ", paste( missing_upstream_files, collapse = ", " ),
      ". Run the frozen 2025 Module 4 first." ) )
}
upstream_validation <- readr::read_csv( upstream_validation_path, show_col_types = FALSE )
assert_columns( upstream_validation, c( "scenario_id", "demand_scenario_id", "check_name", "pass" ),

    demand_scenario_id == config$demand_scenario_id )

}
if ( any( is.na( selected_upstream_validation$pass ) | !selected_upstream_validation$pass )
) {
  failed_upstream_checks <- selected_upstream_validation %>% filter( is.na( pass ) | !pass ) %>% pull( check_name )
  stop( paste0( "Module 4 validation failed for the selected scenario: ", paste( failed_upstream_checks,
        collapse = "; " ) ) )
}

)
```

```{r module-5-conversion-models, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
  "focal_selected_if_purchase", "^market_purchase$" )
```

```{r module-5-conversion-models, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 4. SELECT MARKET AND DEMAND SCENARIO
conversion_data <- conversion_raw %>% filter( scenario_id == config$market_scenario_id, demand_scenario_id ==
      config$demand_scenario_id ) %>% mutate( policy_year = as.integer( policy_year ), technical_data_split =
      tolower( trimws( as.character( technical_data_split ) ) ), conversion_data_split = tolower( trimws(
          as.character( conversion_data_split ) ) ), data_split = tolower( trimws( as.character( data_split ) ) ) )
if ( nrow( conversion_data ) != config$expected_profiles
) {
  stop( paste0( "Module 5 requires exactly ", config$expected_profiles,
      " rows for the selected 2025 scenario; observed ", nrow( conversion_data ), "." ) )
}
if ( anyDuplicated( conversion_data$policy_id ) > 0L || anyDuplicated( conversion_data$quote_profile_id ) > 0L
) {
  stop( "Conversion modelling data must contain unique policy_id and quote_profile_id values." )
}
if ( !all( conversion_data$policy_year == config$expected_policy_year )
) {
  stop( "Module 5 must receive the 2025 quote cohort only." )
}
if ( !all( conversion_data$technical_data_split == "test" )
) {
  stop( "technical_data_split must remain 'test' for every conversion-modelling row." )
}
if ( !all( conversion_data$data_split == conversion_data$conversion_data_split )
) {
  stop( "data_split must remain an exact alias of conversion_data_split." )
}
expected_conversion_splits <- c( "train", "validation", "test" )
if ( !setequal( unique( conversion_data$conversion_data_split ), expected_conversion_splits )
) {
  stop( "conversion_data_split must contain train, validation and test only." )
}
observed_split_counts <- conversion_data %>% count( conversion_data_split, name = "profiles" )
split_count <- function( split_name
) {
  value <- observed_split_counts %>% filter( conversion_data_split == split_name ) %>% pull( profiles )
  if ( length( value ) != 1L
  ) {
    stop( paste0( "Unable to recover exactly one row count for conversion split ", split_name, "." ) )
  }
  as.integer( value )
}
if ( split_count( "train" ) != config$expected_conversion_train_rows || split_count( "validation" ) !=
      config$expected_conversion_validation_rows || split_count( "test" ) != config$expected_conversion_test_rows
) {
  stop( paste0( "Conversion split does not match the frozen 6000/2000/2000 design. ",
      "Observed train/validation/test = ", split_count( "train" ), "/", split_count( "validation" ), "/",
      split_count( "test" ), "." ) )
}
if ( !all( conversion_data$focal_conversion %in% c( 0L, 1L ) )
) {
  stop( "focal_conversion must be binary." )
}
```

```{r module-5-conversion-models, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 5. PREPARE OBSERVABLE PREDICTORS
positive_required_columns <- c( "vehicle_value", "power_kw", "torque_nm", "unladen_weight_kg", "annual_km",
  "estimated_expected_claim_cost", "technical_premium", "focal_quote", "relative_price_to_cheapest_competitor",
  "relative_price_to_market_median", "within_profile_competitor_spread_ratio" )
for ( column_name in positive_required_columns
) {
  column_values <- conversion_data[[ column_name ]]
  if ( any( !is.finite( column_values ) ) || any( column_values <= 0 )
  ) {
    stop( paste0( column_name, " must be finite and strictly positive." ) )
  }
}
nonnegative_vehicle_spec_columns <- c( "engine_capacity_l", "cylinder_count" )
for ( column_name in nonnegative_vehicle_spec_columns
) {
  column_values <- conversion_data[[ column_name ]]
  if ( any( !is.finite( column_values ) ) || any( column_values < 0 )
  ) {
    stop( paste0( column_name, " must be finite and non-negative." ) )
  }
}
if ( anyNA( conversion_data$transmission ) || any( trimws( as.character( conversion_data$transmission ) ) == "" )
) {
  stop( "transmission must be populated for every conversion-modelling row." )
}
n_competitor_quotes_training_mean <- mean( conversion_data$n_competitor_quotes[
      conversion_data$conversion_data_split == "train" ] )
if ( !is.finite( n_competitor_quotes_training_mean )
) {
  stop( "Unable to calculate TRAIN-only competitor-count centering constant." )
}
conversion_data <- conversion_data %>% mutate( conversion_data_split = as.character( conversion_data_split ),
    data_split = conversion_data_split, focal_conversion = as.integer( focal_conversion ), prior_claims_band =
      case_when( prior_claims_5yr <= 0 ~ "0", prior_claims_5yr == 1 ~ "1", prior_claims_5yr == 2 ~ "2", TRUE ~ "3+"
      ), prior_claims_band = factor( prior_claims_band, levels = c( "0", "1", "2", "3+" ) ), state =
      set_reference_level( state, "NSW", "state" ), remoteness_area = set_reference_level( remoteness_area,
        "Major Cities", "remoteness_area" ), vehicle_segment = set_reference_level( vehicle_segment,
        "Small Passenger", "vehicle_segment" ), motive_power = set_reference_level( motive_power, "Petrol",
        "motive_power" ), transmission = as.character( transmission ), voluntary_excess_factor =
      set_reference_level( voluntary_excess, "800", "voluntary_excess" ), log_vehicle_value = log( vehicle_value ),
    log_annual_km = log( annual_km ), log_estimated_loss_cost = log( estimated_expected_claim_cost ),
    log_technical_premium = log( technical_premium ),
    # Identifiable own-price movement around the actuarial benchmark.
    log_focal_to_technical = log( focal_quote / technical_premium ), log_relative_price_to_cheapest = log(
        relative_price_to_cheapest_competitor ), log_relative_price_to_market_median = log(
        relative_price_to_market_median ), log_competitor_spread = log( within_profile_competitor_spread_ratio ),
    gap_above_market_threshold = pmax( percentage_gap_to_cheapest_competitor - config$market_gap_threshold, 0 ),
    n_competitor_quotes_centered = n_competitor_quotes - n_competitor_quotes_training_mean, age_band = cut(
        driver_age, breaks = c( 18, 24, 29, 39, 49, 59, 69, 79, Inf ), include.lowest = TRUE, right = TRUE ) )
if ( !all( conversion_data$conversion_data_split %in% c( "train", "validation", "test" ) ) || !all(
      conversion_data$data_split == conversion_data$conversion_data_split )
) {
  stop( "conversion_data_split/data_split must preserve train, validation and test exactly." )
}
prepared_observable_columns <- c( "driver_age", "licence_years", "prior_claims_band", "claim_free_years", "state",
  "remoteness_area", "vehicle_segment", "motive_power", "engine_capacity_l", "cylinder_count", "power_kw",
  "torque_nm", "unladen_weight_kg", "transmission", "vehicle_age", "log_vehicle_value", "log_annual_km",
  "voluntary_excess_factor", "log_technical_premium", "log_focal_to_technical", "log_relative_price_to_cheapest",
  "focal_rank_percentile", "gap_above_market_threshold", "log_relative_price_to_market_median",
  "log_competitor_spread", "n_competitor_quotes_centered" )
if ( anyNA( conversion_data[ prepared_observable_columns ] )
) {
  stop( "Prepared conversion predictors contain missing values." )
}
finite_numeric_predictors <- c( "driver_age", "licence_years", "claim_free_years", "engine_capacity_l",
  "cylinder_count", "power_kw", "torque_nm", "unladen_weight_kg", "vehicle_age", "log_vehicle_value",
  "log_annual_km", "log_technical_premium", "log_focal_to_technical", "log_relative_price_to_cheapest",
  "focal_rank_percentile", "gap_above_market_threshold", "log_relative_price_to_market_median",
  "log_competitor_spread", "n_competitor_quotes_centered" )
if ( any( !is.finite( as.matrix( conversion_data[ finite_numeric_predictors ] ) ) )
) {
  stop( "Prepared numeric conversion predictors contain non-finite values." )
}
conversion_model_vehicle_specification_audit <- tibble( market_scenario_id = config$market_scenario_id,
  demand_scenario_id = config$demand_scenario_id, profiles = nrow( conversion_data ), policy_year =
    config$expected_policy_year, technical_data_split = "test", conversion_train_profiles = split_count( "train" ),
  conversion_validation_profiles = split_count( "validation" ), conversion_test_profiles = split_count( "test" ),
  valid_engine_capacity_share = mean( is.finite( conversion_data$engine_capacity_l ) &
        conversion_data$engine_capacity_l >= 0 ), valid_cylinder_count_share = mean( is.finite(
        conversion_data$cylinder_count ) & conversion_data$cylinder_count >= 0 ), positive_power_share = mean(
      is.finite( conversion_data$power_kw ) & conversion_data$power_kw > 0 ), positive_torque_share = mean(
      is.finite( conversion_data$torque_nm ) & conversion_data$torque_nm > 0 ), positive_unladen_weight_share =
    mean( is.finite( conversion_data$unladen_weight_kg ) & conversion_data$unladen_weight_kg > 0 ),
  nonblank_transmission_share = mean( !is.na( conversion_data$transmission ) & trimws( as.character(
            conversion_data$transmission ) ) != "" ), included_as_direct_conversion_predictors = FALSE, rationale =
    paste( "Vehicle specifications are retained and audited as observable covariates",
      "but are not forced into the baseline conversion equations because the",
      "Module 4 demand DGP assigns no direct effects to these fields.",
      "The primary Module 5 estimand is the incremental value of own price and", "competitive market position." ) )
```


```{r module-5-conversion-models, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 6. TRAIN / VALIDATION / TEST SPLITS
training_data <- conversion_data %>% filter( conversion_data_split == "train" )
validation_data <- conversion_data %>% filter( conversion_data_split == "validation" )
test_data <- conversion_data %>% filter( conversion_data_split == "test" )
development_data <- conversion_data %>% filter( conversion_data_split %in% c( "train", "validation" ) )
final_training_data <- development_data
if ( nrow( training_data ) != config$expected_conversion_train_rows || nrow( validation_data ) !=
      config$expected_conversion_validation_rows || nrow( test_data ) != config$expected_conversion_test_rows ||
    nrow( development_data ) != config$expected_conversion_train_rows + config$expected_conversion_validation_rows
) {
  stop( "Module 5 partitions do not match the frozen 6000/2000/2000 design." )
}
development_test_overlap <- intersect( development_data$quote_profile_id, test_data$quote_profile_id )
if ( length( development_test_overlap ) > 0L
) {
  stop( "Conversion TEST observations have leaked into development data." )
}
split_event_counts <- conversion_data %>% group_by( conversion_data_split ) %>% summarise( profiles = n(),
    conversions = sum( focal_conversion ), nonconversions = sum( focal_conversion == 0L ), conversion_rate = mean(
        focal_conversion ), .groups = "drop" ) %>% mutate( data_split = conversion_data_split, .after =
      conversion_data_split )
training_events <- split_event_counts$conversions[ split_event_counts$conversion_data_split == "train" ]
validation_events <- split_event_counts$conversions[ split_event_counts$conversion_data_split == "validation" ]
test_events <- split_event_counts$conversions[ split_event_counts$conversion_data_split == "test" ]
if ( length( training_events ) != 1L || training_events < config$minimum_training_events
) {
  stop( "The training sample has too few focal conversions for stable modelling." )
}
if ( length( validation_events ) != 1L || validation_events < config$minimum_validation_events
) {
  stop( "The validation sample has too few focal conversions." )
}
if ( length( test_events ) != 1L || test_events < config$minimum_test_events
) {
  stop( "The test sample has too few focal conversions." )
}
if ( any( split_event_counts$conversions <= 0L ) || any( split_event_counts$nonconversions <= 0L )
) {
  stop( "Every conversion partition must contain both outcome classes." )
}
```


```{r module-5-conversion-models, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 7. FACTOR-LEVEL SUPPORT CHECK
factor_predictors <- c( "prior_claims_band", "state", "remoteness_area", "vehicle_segment", "motive_power",
  "voluntary_excess_factor" )
training_level_check <- purrr::map_dfr( factor_predictors, function( variable_name
    ) {
      full_levels <- levels( conversion_data[[ variable_name ]] )
      training_levels <- unique( as.character( training_data[[ variable_name ]] ) )
      missing_training_levels <- setdiff( full_levels, training_levels )
      tibble( variable = variable_name, full_levels = paste( full_levels, collapse = " | " ),
        missing_from_training = paste( missing_training_levels, collapse = " | " ), pass = length(
            missing_training_levels ) == 0L )
    } )
if ( !all( training_level_check$pass )
) {
  stop( paste( "Some factor levels are absent from training data.",
      "Review training_factor_level_check.csv before fitting." ) )
}
```


```{r module-5-conversion-models, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 8. MODEL FORMULAS
# Technical/customer information only.
# The frozen CarExpert vehicle-specification fields are retained and audited in
# this module but are not forced into the conversion equations. Module 4 assigns
# no direct demand effects to those fields; the primary research comparison is
# therefore kept focused on own price and competitive market position.
# log_technical_premium is included as a compact actuarial risk-level summary.
# The remaining observable characteristics allow conversion to vary by customer
# profile even before commercial price and market position are introduced.
technical_formula <- focal_conversion ~ splines::ns( driver_age, df = 4 ) + splines::ns( licence_years, df = 3 ) +
    prior_claims_band + splines::ns( claim_free_years, df = 3 ) + state + remoteness_area + vehicle_segment +
    motive_power + splines::ns( vehicle_age, df = 3 ) + log_vehicle_value + log_annual_km +
    voluntary_excess_factor + log_technical_premium
# Adds the focal insurer's commercial price movement around technical premium.
own_price_formula <- focal_conversion ~ splines::ns( driver_age, df = 4 ) + splines::ns( licence_years, df = 3 ) +
    prior_claims_band + splines::ns( claim_free_years, df = 3 ) + state + remoteness_area + vehicle_segment +
    motive_power + splines::ns( vehicle_age, df = 3 ) + log_vehicle_value + log_annual_km +
    voluntary_excess_factor + log_technical_premium + log_focal_to_technical
# Adds focal price relative to the cheapest returned competitor.
relative_price_formula <- focal_conversion ~ splines::ns( driver_age, df = 4 ) + splines::ns( licence_years, df = 3
    ) + prior_claims_band + splines::ns( claim_free_years, df = 3 ) + state + remoteness_area + vehicle_segment +
    motive_power + splines::ns( vehicle_age, df = 3 ) + log_vehicle_value + log_annual_km +
    voluntary_excess_factor + log_technical_premium + log_focal_to_technical + log_relative_price_to_cheapest
# Adds rank alone as the market-position variable.
rank_formula <- focal_conversion ~ splines::ns( driver_age, df = 4 ) + splines::ns( licence_years, df = 3 ) +
    prior_claims_band + splines::ns( claim_free_years, df = 3 ) + state + remoteness_area + vehicle_segment +
    motive_power + splines::ns( vehicle_age, df = 3 ) + log_vehicle_value + log_annual_km +
    voluntary_excess_factor + log_technical_premium + log_focal_to_technical + focal_rank_percentile
# Combined interpretable market-position GLM.
full_market_glm_formula <- focal_conversion ~ splines::ns( driver_age, df = 4 ) + splines::ns( licence_years,
      df = 3 ) + prior_claims_band + splines::ns( claim_free_years, df = 3 ) + state + remoteness_area +
    vehicle_segment + motive_power + splines::ns( vehicle_age, df = 3 ) + log_vehicle_value + log_annual_km +
    voluntary_excess_factor + log_technical_premium + log_focal_to_technical + log_relative_price_to_cheapest +
    focal_rank_percentile + gap_above_market_threshold + log_relative_price_to_market_median +
    log_competitor_spread + n_competitor_quotes_centered
# Flexible nonlinear market-position comparator.
# The GAM remains deliberately lower-dimensional than the true Module 4
# random-utility law and receives no latent taste or heterogeneous sensitivity
# variables.
full_market_gam_formula <- focal_conversion ~ s( driver_age, k = 5, bs = "cr" ) + s( licence_years, k = 4,
      bs = "cr" ) + prior_claims_band + s( claim_free_years, k = 4, bs = "cr" ) + state + remoteness_area +
    vehicle_segment + motive_power + s( vehicle_age, k = 4, bs = "cr" ) + s( log_vehicle_value, k = 5, bs = "cr"
    ) + s( log_annual_km, k = 5, bs = "cr" ) + voluntary_excess_factor + s( log_technical_premium, k = 5, bs = "cr"
    ) + s( log_focal_to_technical, k = 5, bs = "cr" ) + s( log_relative_price_to_cheapest, k = 6, bs = "cr" ) + s(
      focal_rank_percentile, k = 5, bs = "cr" ) + gap_above_market_threshold + s(
      log_relative_price_to_market_median, k = 5, bs = "cr" ) + s( log_competitor_spread, k = 4, bs = "cr" ) +
    n_competitor_quotes_centered
model_definitions <- list( "Technical-only GLM" = list( formula = technical_formula, type = "glm",
      benchmark_stage = "Technical/customer characteristics only" ), "Own-price GLM" = list( formula =
        own_price_formula, type = "glm", benchmark_stage =
        "Adds focal commercial price relative to technical premium" ), "Relative-price GLM" = list( formula =
        relative_price_formula, type = "glm", benchmark_stage = "Adds focal price relative to cheapest competitor"
    ), "Rank GLM" = list( formula = rank_formula, type = "glm", benchmark_stage =
        "Adds focal quote rank percentile" ), "Market-position GLM" = list( formula = full_market_glm_formula,
      type = "glm", benchmark_stage = "Adds combined market-position information" ), "Market-position GAM" = list(
      formula = full_market_gam_formula, type = "gam", benchmark_stage =
        "Flexible smooth nonlinear market-position model" ) )
model_formula_register <- purrr::imap_dfr( model_definitions, function( definition, model_name
    ) {
      tibble( model = model_name, model_type = definition$type, benchmark_stage = definition$benchmark_stage,
        formula = paste( deparse( definition$formula, width.cutoff = 500 ), collapse = " " ) )
    } )
```


```{r module-5-conversion-models, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 9. FIT DEVELOPMENT MODELS ON TRAIN ONLY
development_models <- purrr::imap( model_definitions, function( definition, model_name
    ) {
      fit_model_safely( formula = definition$formula, data = training_data, model_type = definition$type,
        model_name = model_name )
    } )
development_models <- development_models[ !purrr::map_lgl( development_models, is.null ) ]
required_glm_gam_models <- c( "Technical-only GLM", "Own-price GLM", "Relative-price GLM", "Rank GLM",
  "Market-position GLM", "Market-position GAM" )
missing_required_models <- setdiff( required_glm_gam_models, names( development_models ) )
if ( length( missing_required_models ) > 0L
) {
  stop( paste0( "Required GLM/GAM models failed to fit: ", paste( missing_required_models, collapse = ", " ) ) )
}
```


```{r module-5-conversion-models, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 10. DEVELOPMENT PREDICTIONS AND MODEL METRICS
# TEST is deliberately excluded before model-family selection.
development_prediction_long <- purrr::imap_dfr( development_models, function( model_object, model_name
    ) {
      predicted_probability <- predict_probability_safely( model = model_object, new_data = development_data,
          model_name = model_name )
      development_data %>% transmute( scenario_id, demand_scenario_id, policy_id, quote_profile_id, policy_year,
          technical_data_split, conversion_data_split, data_split, focal_conversion, focal_rank,
          focal_rank_percentile, relative_price_to_cheapest_competitor, age_band, vehicle_segment, model =
            model_name, predicted_probability = predicted_probability )
    } )
if ( any( development_prediction_long$conversion_data_split == "test" )
) {
  stop( "TEST predictions were generated before model selection." )
}
development_model_metrics <- development_prediction_long %>% group_by( model, conversion_data_split ) %>%
  nest() %>% mutate( metrics = purrr::map( data, function( group_data
        ) {
          binary_model_metrics( group_data$focal_conversion, group_data$predicted_probability )
        } ) ) %>% dplyr::select( -data ) %>% unnest( metrics ) %>% ungroup() %>% mutate( data_split =
      conversion_data_split, .after = conversion_data_split )
training_aic <- purrr::imap_dfr( development_models, function( model_object, model_name
    ) {
      model_aic <- tryCatch( stats::AIC( model_object ),
          error = function(e) {
            NA_real_
          } )
      tibble( model = model_name, training_aic = model_aic )
    } )
development_model_metrics <- development_model_metrics %>% left_join( training_aic, by = "model" ) %>% left_join(
    model_formula_register %>% dplyr::select( model, model_type, benchmark_stage ), by = "model" )
validation_model_metrics <- development_model_metrics %>% filter( conversion_data_split == "validation" ) %>%
  arrange( log_loss )
```


```{r module-5-conversion-models, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 11. SELECT FULL MARKET MODEL USING VALIDATION ONLY
# The Market-position GLM is the parsimonious default. The Market-position GAM is
# selected only if:
#   1. validation log loss improves by at least 0.5% relative to the GLM; and
#   2. the GAM validation calibration slope remains within the pre-specified band.
# TEST performance is not considered in this decision.
full_candidate_names <- c( "Market-position GLM", "Market-position GAM" )
full_validation_metrics <- validation_model_metrics %>% filter( model %in% full_candidate_names )
if ( nrow( full_validation_metrics ) != 2L
) {
  stop( "Both Market-position GLM and Market-position GAM validation metrics are required." )
}
glm_validation_row <- full_validation_metrics %>% filter( model == "Market-position GLM" )
gam_validation_row <- full_validation_metrics %>% filter( model == "Market-position GAM" )
glm_validation_log_loss <- glm_validation_row$log_loss[ 1 ]
gam_relative_logloss_improvement_vs_glm <- safe_divide( glm_validation_log_loss - gam_validation_row$log_loss[ 1 ],
    glm_validation_log_loss )
gam_validation_calibration_acceptable <- is.finite( gam_validation_row$calibration_slope[ 1 ] ) &&
  gam_validation_row$calibration_slope[ 1 ] >= config$gam_calibration_slope_lower &&
  gam_validation_row$calibration_slope[ 1 ] <= config$gam_calibration_slope_upper
gam_complexity_threshold_met <- is.finite( gam_relative_logloss_improvement_vs_glm ) &&
  gam_relative_logloss_improvement_vs_glm >= config$minimum_relative_logloss_improvement_for_gam
full_selection_table <- full_validation_metrics %>% mutate( relative_logloss_improvement_vs_glm = safe_divide(
        glm_validation_log_loss - log_loss, glm_validation_log_loss ), minimum_required_improvement = if_else(
        model == "Market-position GAM", config$minimum_relative_logloss_improvement_for_gam, 0 ),
    calibration_slope_lower = if_else( model == "Market-position GAM", config$gam_calibration_slope_lower, -Inf ),
    calibration_slope_upper = if_else( model == "Market-position GAM", config$gam_calibration_slope_upper, Inf ),
    calibration_acceptable = if_else( model == "Market-position GAM", is.finite( calibration_slope ) &
          calibration_slope >= calibration_slope_lower & calibration_slope <= calibration_slope_upper, TRUE ),
    complexity_threshold_met = if_else( model == "Market-position GAM", is.finite(
          relative_logloss_improvement_vs_glm ) & relative_logloss_improvement_vs_glm >=
            minimum_required_improvement, TRUE ), eligible_for_selection = calibration_acceptable &
        complexity_threshold_met )
selected_development_model_name <- "Market-position GLM"
selection_reason <- paste( "The Market-position GLM was retained because the GAM did not satisfy both",
    "the pre-specified 0.5% validation log-loss improvement threshold and the",
    "validation calibration requirement." )
if ( gam_complexity_threshold_met && gam_validation_calibration_acceptable
) {
  selected_development_model_name <- "Market-position GAM"
  selection_reason <- paste0( "Market-position GAM reduced validation log loss by ", round( 100 *
          gam_relative_logloss_improvement_vs_glm, 2 ),
      "% relative to the Market-position GLM and retained acceptable ", "validation calibration." )
}
selected_definition <- model_definitions[[ selected_development_model_name ]]
```


```{r module-5-conversion-models, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 12. REFIT ALL PRE-SPECIFIED MODELS ON TRAIN + VALIDATION
# Refit all six GLM/GAM candidates after the validation-only selection decision.
# This permits fair held-out TEST reporting without using TEST for selection.
final_models <- purrr::imap( model_definitions, function( definition, model_name
    ) {
      fit_model_safely( formula = definition$formula, data = final_training_data, model_type = definition$type,
        model_name = paste0( "Final ", model_name ) )
    } )
final_models <- final_models[ !purrr::map_lgl( final_models, is.null ) ]
missing_final_required_models <- setdiff( required_glm_gam_models, names( final_models ) )
if ( length( missing_final_required_models ) > 0L
) {
  stop( paste0( "Required final GLM/GAM models failed to fit: ", paste( missing_final_required_models,
        collapse = ", " ) ) )
}
if ( !selected_development_model_name %in% names( final_models )
) {
  stop( "The selected model failed during final train-plus-validation refitting." )
}
final_selected_model <- final_models[[ selected_development_model_name ]]
```

```{r module-5-conversion-models, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}

    ) {
```

```{r module-5-conversion-models, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 14. INCREMENTAL VALUE OF MARKET POSITION
build_incremental_value <- function( metrics_table, evaluation_split
) {
  own_price_row <- metrics_table %>% filter( model == "Own-price GLM" )
  technical_row <- metrics_table %>% filter( model == "Technical-only GLM" )
  if ( nrow( own_price_row ) != 1L || nrow( technical_row ) != 1L
  ) {
    stop( paste0( "Benchmark rows are missing when constructing incremental value for ", evaluation_split, "." ) )
  }
  metrics_table %>% mutate( evaluation_split = evaluation_split, technical_log_loss = technical_row$log_loss[ 1 ],
      own_price_log_loss = own_price_row$log_loss[ 1 ], technical_auc = technical_row$auc[ 1 ], own_price_auc =
        own_price_row$auc[ 1 ], log_loss_improvement_vs_technical = technical_log_loss - log_loss,
      relative_log_loss_improvement_vs_technical = safe_divide( technical_log_loss - log_loss, technical_log_loss
        ), auc_improvement_vs_technical = auc - technical_auc, log_loss_improvement_vs_own_price =
        own_price_log_loss - log_loss, relative_log_loss_improvement_vs_own_price = safe_divide(
          own_price_log_loss - log_loss, own_price_log_loss ), auc_improvement_vs_own_price = auc - own_price_auc
    ) %>% dplyr::select( evaluation_split, model, log_loss, brier_score, auc, expected_calibration_error,
      log_loss_improvement_vs_technical, relative_log_loss_improvement_vs_technical, auc_improvement_vs_technical,
      log_loss_improvement_vs_own_price, relative_log_loss_improvement_vs_own_price, auc_improvement_vs_own_price )
}
validation_incremental_value <- build_incremental_value( validation_model_metrics, "validation" )
test_incremental_value <- build_incremental_value( test_model_metrics, "test" )
incremental_model_value <- bind_rows( validation_incremental_value, test_incremental_value )
```

```{r module-5-conversion-models, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
  "Vehicle specification audit complete in Module 5", min( c(
```

```{r module-5-conversion-models, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 21. DIAGNOSTIC PLOTS
if ( isTRUE( config$write_plots )
) {
  model_order <- validation_model_metrics %>% arrange( log_loss ) %>% pull( model )
  p_validation_logloss <- validation_model_metrics %>% mutate( model = factor( model, levels = rev( model_order ) )
    ) %>% ggplot( aes( x = model, y = log_loss ) ) + geom_col() + coord_flip() + labs( x = NULL,
      y = "Validation log loss", title = "Conversion-model validation comparison" ) + theme_minimal()
  ggsave( file.path( config$output_dir, "01_validation_log_loss.png" ), p_validation_logloss, width = 8,
    height = 5, dpi = 300 )
  p_validation_auc <- validation_model_metrics %>% mutate( model = factor( model, levels = rev( model_order ) )
    ) %>% ggplot( aes( x = model, y = auc ) ) + geom_col() + coord_flip() + labs( x = NULL, y = "Validation AUC",
      title = "Conversion-model discrimination" ) + theme_minimal()
  ggsave( file.path( config$output_dir, "02_validation_auc.png" ), p_validation_auc, width = 8, height = 5,
    dpi = 300 )
  p_calibration <- selected_calibration_by_probability_decile %>% ggplot( aes( x = predicted_conversion_rate, y =
          observed_conversion_rate ) ) + geom_point() + geom_abline( slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = 2 ) +
    labs( x = "Mean predicted conversion", y = "Observed conversion", title = "Held-out selected-model calibration"
    ) + theme_minimal()
  ggsave( file.path( config$output_dir, "03_selected_model_calibration.png" ), p_calibration, width = 6,
    height = 6, dpi = 300 )
  p_rank_calibration <- selected_calibration_by_rank %>% dplyr::select( focal_rank, observed_conversion_rate,
      predicted_conversion_rate ) %>% pivot_longer( cols = c( observed_conversion_rate, predicted_conversion_rate
      ), names_to = "series", values_to = "conversion_rate" ) %>% mutate( series = recode( series,
          observed_conversion_rate = "Observed", predicted_conversion_rate = "Predicted" ) ) %>% ggplot( aes( x =
          focal_rank, y = conversion_rate, linetype = series ) ) + geom_line() + geom_point() + labs(
      x = "Focal quote rank", y = "Conversion rate", linetype = NULL, title = "Held-out conversion by market rank"
    ) + theme_minimal()
  ggsave( file.path( config$output_dir, "04_selected_model_conversion_by_rank.png" ), p_rank_calibration,
    width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300 )
  truth_plot_data <- final_prediction_long %>% filter( data_split == "test", model %in% c( "Own-price GLM",
            selected_development_model_name ) ) %>% left_join( truth_data %>% filter( scenario_id ==
              config$market_scenario_id, demand_scenario_id == config$demand_scenario_id, data_split == "test"
          ) %>% dplyr::select( policy_id, quote_profile_id, true_focal_conversion_probability ), by = c(
          "policy_id", "quote_profile_id" ) )
  p_truth_recovery <- ggplot( truth_plot_data, aes( x = true_focal_conversion_probability, y =
            predicted_probability ) ) + geom_point( alpha = 0.15 ) + facet_wrap( vars( model ) ) + geom_abline(
        slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = 2 ) + labs( x = "Known true conversion probability",
        y = "Fitted conversion probability", title = "Held-out recovery of synthetic conversion truth" ) +
      theme_minimal()
  ggsave( file.path( config$output_dir, "05_truth_probability_recovery.png" ), p_truth_recovery, width = 10,
    height = 5, dpi = 300 )
}
```
